parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 8. This significantly dropped val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Capacity seems to be a major driver under this 5-minute budget. Next: scaling MATRIX_LR to compensate for the higher capacity and potential instability.
parsed.description: Increasing depth to 8 (already done in last run, but keeping in state) and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to see if higher capacity requires a higher learning rate to converge faster.
